structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation and Boards Within the Department
Asbestos, Lead, and Home Inspection Contractors and Workers

law.text: The Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation shall include with every asbestos worker's license a notice, in English and Spanish, containing a summary of the basic worker safety procedures regarding the handling of asbestos and information on how to file a complaint with the Virginia Board for Asbestos, Lead, and Home Inspectors.
